display_name: 从零 30 轮条件生成流与冻结 F0 身份引导恢复网络
description: 独立从零训练 30 轮注意力条件流，混合合法 R07、G10 L_s 和 clean 源配对；固定两条反向噪声轨迹输出，完成全部七景与 Phase3 冻结评测。

data.representation: Original source paired clean/R07 2.462 GHz L_s/U_s and fixed G10 MIX01 2.45 GHz L_s received matched by exact physical IDs; clean branch
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels; original frozen source F0 features guide G. No V/OE/novel or target IQ in G training; truth only after all predictions.
data.augmentation: Existing R07 source views 01..20 then repeat 01..10; fixed G10 L_s view repeated; no new physical observations

permissions.regime: Source L_s/U_s training with frozen original supervised source F0 feature knowledge; no target adaptation or training on heldout source data
permissions.query_use: Independent frozen per-record prediction; no target U, selection, tuning or threshold fitting
permissions.claim_scope: Development RX34 fixed Phase3 G10 and historical F50 full seven-view tests; original Phase3 PCD has target-U576 ancestry and DURA-calibrated thresholds; no blind or new registration claim.

checkpoint.initialization: 160200-parameter scratch conditional flow; F0 source E50/11100 frozen for feature guidance; no G/DURA parent weights
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original F0 E50/11100 with supervised source identity knowledge; F0/G source physical role contracts and G10 L_s ID sets must match; existing target-U576 only in downstream fixed PCD, not G training.
checkpoint.selection_rule: One fixed E30/14790 final checkpoint and two fixed antithetic inference paths; no model, path, or threshold selection from target results.

metric_names: historical F50 accuracy and raw-clean gap by scene, TX, RX and day
historical clean damage and paired DURA repairs/damages
Phase3 original-F0 same-ID per-scene raw-clean gap
fixed PCD A_K/C_K/R_U/H-score and paired DURA changes
matched latency, throughput, memory and 8 velocity-field calls
dimensions: source V and full 168000 historical target physical records x seven views
Phase3 source V/novel and same 10238 clean/star physical records
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Every six scenes raw-clean minus restored star F0 macro <=3pp; clean degradation <=1pp; Phase3 CK>=90%, clean RU>=95%, star RU>=90%, same-G closed-open loss<=2pp; registration independent.

rows.method: Scratch full-window conditional Transformer velocity field with frozen F0 source identity and two fixed antithetic output paths
rows.purpose: Alternative generative restoration and mandatory fixed-system assessment
rows.seed_notes: model 2026092701, source-order 2026110104, flow 2026110105, fixed antithetic output template 2026110103; original source split and fixed evaluation seeds retained
rows.scenario: R07 source L_s/U_s plus fixed source G10 L_s and clean; frozen historical seven views plus fixed Phase3 source and RX34

notes: Distinct primary route from the other chat: multi-step conditional generative attention flow, not deterministic time/frequency residual; historical R20 used different DURA/soft-MAP conditional flow and failed, and flow novelty or superiority is not claimed.

G10 L_s has only 6300 physical IDs and one fixed MIX01 view; repeated uses are not independent observations. Source R07 2.462 GHz is not G10 2.45 GHz. No sample labels or target IQ read in G training.

Frozen F0 carries supervised source identity knowledge. Two-path objective is mean flow loss + F0 feature anchor + 0.25 feature agreement; Gaussian scale .02, uniform time, AdamW peak .0003 final .00002 warmup493, clip1, fixed E30.
Fixed two opposite common noise templates, 4 Euler steps each and mean IQ; no prediction-, target-, label- or confidence-based choice. No posterior calibration claimed.

Two-source actual F0 gradient test VERIFIED; 14 focused tests passed; independent source and execution P0/P1 review found no unresolved issue; actual G10/F0 source checkpoint smoke runs before GPU admission.
All historical source/target seven-view predictions and Phase3 source V/novel and clean/star complete before any CPU scorer reads truth. Poor metrics do not cancel predeclared evaluations.

Fixed downstream F0/E0/PCD and DURA reference; PCD contains historical target-U576 ancestry and thresholds calibrated for DURA, therefore compare fixed system only and do not claim open-world registration completed.

Independent scratch E30 satisfies the specified 30-epoch budget. It does not load the running E20 pilot checkpoint or use E20 target results; R07 views 01–20 repeat 01–10 during epochs 21–30, not new independent views.
Source validation and independent E30 budget review passed; fixed 15 targeted tests passed. Actual source G10/F0 smoke remains mandatory before GPU work.
Registry seed correction: data-order=2026110104 and flow-noise/time=2026110105, as fixed in code and seed_notes; evaluation receiver seed=2027, fixed inference template seed=2026110103.
